generation_zero.mechanism: Replace symmetric hashing with pinned local MiniLM dense embeddings; preserve record chunking.
Attenuate existing association and topic expansion weights by one fixed factor.
Reduce document-length normalization while preserving term and title weights.
Increase the existing BM25 title field weight while preserving body weight and normalization.

generation_one.rule: Only merge non-conflicting operations already supported by complementary development cases; require ancestry in the native Pareto archive. No new mechanisms or validation feedback.

primary_metric: binary nDCG@10 on the fixed default route of each family
validation_proposal: Two fresh source-separated BEIR-derived cohorts, twelve seeded queries each, reference-enriched corpus of at least 985 documents; not full BEIR or answer-quality evaluation.
